name: reboot-residue R-002 live: disk-cold Ornith served through the :8788 gateway on demand, 200 after 353s, no OOM/drift
summary: Live probe of AUTO-BAR-R-002-P-002@5 on the dev box, from a verified disk-cold state: llama-ornith.service inactive and the model blob evicted from the page cache. A normal-operation POST http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1/chat/completions naming maxwell1500/ornith-35b:IQ3_M made the gateway start llama-ornith on demand. The gateway's unit audit was clean against catalog 'ornith-35b-iq3m-llama-server', and the request returned HTTP 200 with a choices array after 353s. Immediately afterwards :11435 /v1/models answered 200 listing the Ornith alias, and /admin/local-backends reported ornith-llamaserver enabled:true. ollama and kokoro stayed active with ollama NRestarts unchanged (14211 -> 14211). The gateway journal had zero OOM/load-fail/drift lines, and the llama-server log had zero cudaMalloc/OOM/load-error lines plus 2 loaded/listening lines.
scope: Live host plane. The probe sends one completion and reads state; it does not edit units or catalogs. To reach the cold state, llama-ornith was stopped by hand at 07:38:08Z and the blob's page cache dropped with posix_fadvise(DONTNEED). The stop reproduced the idle-backend-reaper's normal end state; the reaper was overdue since 07:30:07Z (tracked separately, WI-10006506). The 900s cold-start budget is the WI-10006503 fix. The gateway serving this probe runs from the canonical tree (npx tsx packages/operator-core/lib/inference-gateway/bin.ts) and its unit entered active at 07:30:15Z, after launch.ts changed at 07:17:48Z, so it ran the fixed budget. The pre-fix budget (300s) is below the measured 353s, so the same request would have returned 502.
oracle: Independent of the repair: systemd unit state and NRestarts, nvidia-smi, posix_fadvise eviction confirmed by the host Cached drop and a disk-speed 1 GiB read, HTTP status codes and response bodies from :8788 and :11435, and journal/log line counts. The only gateway-reported value read is the /admin/local-backends row, which the clause names. No papercusp test result or work-item claim is consulted.
redaction: Home directory rendered as $HOME, user and host names replaced. The /v1/models body line is omitted because it only echoes the alias.

coldState.mincoreNote: A mincore residency check was not used: it reported 100% even on a freshly evicted control file.

assertions.evidence: PRE ornith=inactive. Host Cached fell 23371756 -> 15568852 kB after the fadvise, and the first 1 GiB of the blob read in 9655 ms, which is disk speed rather than page-cache speed.

Gateway journal 07:40:29Z: 'local backend ornith-llamaserver (llama-ornith.service) is not answering — starting it on demand'. 07:45:03Z: 'started on demand and is answering — routing resumed'. The llama-ornith journal shows systemd starting the unit at 07:40:29Z.
Gateway journal 07:40:29Z: 'unit audit clean for ornith-llamaserver — unit matches catalog ornith-35b-iq3m-llama-server (params, required env, engine binary)'.
COMPLETION_HTTP=200 after 353s, response model maxwell1500/ornith-35b:IQ3_M, choices present (COMPLETION_HAS_CHOICES=1).
GET :11435/v1/models -> 200 and the body names maxwell1500/ornith-35b:IQ3_M (MODELS_11435_HAS_ORNITH=1).

POST ornith=active, ollama=active with NRestarts 14211 -> 14211, kokoro=active. The pre-existing GPU apps (node 1818 MiB, kokoro 1020 MiB, node 5982 MiB) are still present and unchanged after the load; llama-server added 13678 MiB.
GATEWAY_BAD_LINES=0 (oom|out of memory|load fail|failed to load|drift). LLAMA_LOG_BAD_LINES=0 (cudaMalloc failed|out of memory|failed to load model|error loading model). LLAMA_LOG_LOADED=2.

Disclosure, not a failure: a 07:43:05Z gateway line 'claude upstream failed: fetch failed (ETIMEDOUT)' matched the probe's broad 'fail' display filter. It is a Claude-account upstream request, not the Ornith path, and it does not match the GATEWAY_BAD_LINES pattern.
